question: What was the year-over-year growth in claim counts from 2023 to 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM claim_date)=2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM claim_date)=2023 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM claim_date)=2023 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM claims
